source_tweet.text:
🎮🖥️《 PS5 & PC Shared Update Details》

🔶 Bayonetta Collaboration Costumes
The enchanting style of an Umbra Witch has arrived in EVE’s world from another dimension! Acquire the Bayonetta collaboration outfits and step into battle with an elegant, bold new look.

4 Nanosuits
└ Couture Bullet (Bayonetta)
└ Couture Bullet (Jeanne)
└ Couture Bullet (Nun)
└ Couture Bullet (Black Tresses)

2 Pairs of Glasses
└ Bayonetta's Glasses
└ Nun's Glasses

2 Pairs of Earrings
└ Bayonetta's Earrings
└ Jeanne's Earrings

🔸 Fixed an issue where the side quest <A United People Cannot be Defeated> would not progress after obtaining two Memory Sticks.
🔸 Fixed an issue where Emil would occasionally get stuck on a cliff in the southern Wasteland and could not be attacked.
🔸 Fixed an issue where EVE’s hairstyle would not appear in the Equipment and Repair Console screens.
🔸 Fixed an issue in Adam's entry in the Data Bank.

🖥️ PC // VERSION 1.5.0 UPDATE DETAILS

🔸 Fixed an issue where rapidly switching cosmetics could cause EVE’s appearance in the Equipment screen to differ from the selected item.
🔸 [Steam Deck] When Steam Input is enabled, button icons and controller images now match the connected controller.
